description: This file defines the exception class PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException, which is used to signal when a policy entry is either not found or access is denied in the context of policy management within the project. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages and JSON, as well as a builder class for fluent creation.

classes.name: PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a specific policy entry was either not found or access is denied, including static methods for creation and a builder class for fluent instantiation.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException with a fluent interface.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with specified policy ID and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
